fields.summary: Historical FDA recall Z-0341-05 for Philips HeartStart MRx monitor/defibrillator models M3535A and M3536A. The recall concerns a possible delay in energy delivery when the sync function is enabled and the device switches from manual to AED mode. FDA lists software versions A.02.00 and lower in the code information. Philips notified customers by letter in December 2004, with interim risk mitigation pending correction by a company representative. The recall was initiated on 2004-12-15 and terminated on 2016-02-02. This historical record does not establish current patch availability or provide specific software-update or monitoring instructions.
